This small sorghum plot is just a corner of my land, but sorghum feeds my family, so I will care for it. I have no cash to waste — I will put a little fertilizer, what the cooperative gives us, because the soil here is tired, and I will also spread manure from our animals since that costs nothing. I will plant the seed I saved from last year, as my mother did; the improved seeds at the cooperative are expensive and I do not know them well. I will weed with my own hands and my children's help — we do not need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
